meta_description:
live.momentous on October 31, 2026: "The countdown to race day is on. Before @richroll lines up tomorrow, take a closer look at the work that’s helped him get here.

Preparing for 26.2 miles has meant keeping things simple. Rich’s training for the @nycmarathon has focused on core work, functional strength, and showing up consistently.

📺 Catch up on all three Rebuild films on YouTube before race day. 🔗 in bio.".
